Piotroski F-Score / Visegrad firm panel (Paper A application)

Source: R/data.R
fscore.Rd

Hand-collected firm–year panel of Piotroski F-Scores and one-year-ahead returns for firms on the Warsaw, Budapest and Prague exchanges, 2010–2024, consolidated from the three exchange production files. Paper A uses the firm and country–year specification for a complete exact-inference workflow. The diffuse-regime variance companion also uses seven outcome/subsample/FE variants to compare HC0–HC3 behavior.

Usage

fscore

Format

A data frame with 217 firm-year rows and 6 variables:

uid

firm ticker (unit id)

year

fiscal year (time id)

country

Poland, Hungary or Czech Republic

status

"active" or "delisted"

fscore

Piotroski F-Score, 0–9 integer composite (the regressor)

ret

one-year-ahead return (outcome)

Source

Hand-collected from Warsaw (WSE), Budapest (BSE) and Prague (PSE) exchange filings; the panel of Paper A's empirical application.

Examples

# Paper A specification: log return on F-Score, firm + country-year effects
cy <- interaction(fscore$country, fscore$year, drop = TRUE)
cycle_capture(fscore$fscore, fscore$uid, cy)
#> [1] 0.8273879
